blocks.text: The Heights home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

36 houses sold in The Heights with a median price of $1,420,000 (the middle half sold between $1,208,250 and $1,613,750), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 96.6% of the last list price; 8% sold above list. They had a median $580 per square foot, a median year built of 1954 and a median lot of 6,105 square feet.
